confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge only (no extra context supplied); no menus, booking pages, or listings were inspected. Cafe and restaurant anchors are most reliable; July peak-season hostel and hotel rates are least certain and vary by district and booking date. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the draft-beer price (about 2.1x and 1.4x) because direct local knowledge is weaker. The FX figure came from search-indexed copies of the RBA exchange-rates page rather than a direct page read; verify the 2026-10-15 value on rba.gov.au before formal use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Central European tourist cities (e.g., Prague, Budapest, Gdansk, Wroclaw), adjusted to Polish price levels with a July peak-season uplift for accommodation; no named listings or price pages were used.

anchor_basis.beer: domestic draft lager, 0.5 L, at an ordinary central restaurant, about 17 PLN
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a city-centre cafe, about 14 PLN
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: pierogi or a Polish stew main at a casual eatery, about 42 PLN
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: starter, main and dessert for two at a mid-range restaurant, about 280 PLN total
anchor_basis.cocktail: classic cocktail at a city-centre bar, about 36 PLN
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house glass of wine (about 150 ml) at a restaurant, about 24 PLN

anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double at a registered central hostel in July, about 300 PLN
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic registered guesthouse double with private bath in July, about 320 PLN
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: registered three-star hotel double in a central district in July, about 550 PLN
